message: XVatsim 1.2.2 is available. Download the freeware Windows XP12 package from X-Plane.org.
release_notes: Ranks arrival Centers ahead of Approach, Tower, Ground, and CTAF/UNICOM rows, including arrival-relevant next-polygon Centers.
Prevents tuned stale Centers from overriding route polygon ownership after current/next polygon transitions.
Reuses cached route-owned authority proofs across stable route-window transitions and controller/source churn.
Contains expensive overlay window visibility, fronting, and sound operations outside the recurring hot path.
Preserves brain-owned display order, standby assist consumption order, and the existing authority ownership guardrails.
